title: 钩针玩偶
prompt: Create a 3D photorealistic and highly detailed poster in amigurumi style. The design should imitate a real handmade crochet [ANIMAL], with visible thread texture, stitching details, and soft, felted proportions. Use realistic fabric shading, subtle fuzz, and natural lighting to achieve depth. The amigurumi should have small embroidered eyes and a simplified face. Represent it in a neutral studio environment with soft shadows for a professional presentation. Gray toned background.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松创作逼真的钩针玩偶海报，结合 3D 写实风格与细腻的编织纹理，适合自然摄影、动物主题艺术印刷或专业工作室展示。通过柔和光影与织物细节，提升视觉吸引力，打造沉浸式艺术项目。
